counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化层级化知识库文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中建立结构化的知识库
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up a structured knowledge base in your project

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 扫描项目结构,按目录复杂度给根目录和符合条件的子目录分别生成或更新 AGENTS.md 文档;文档内含项目概述、代码地图、约定与反模式等板块。
howto.when: 用户输入 /init-deep 命令,或要求初始化/重建项目的 AGENTS.md 文档结构时触发;支持 --create-new(整体重建)和 --max-depth(限制目录深度)等参数。

say.text: 给这个项目生成分层的 AGENTS.md 文档
say.note: 会扫描结构并按复杂度决定放哪些目录

say.text: 重建 AGENTS.md,先读旧的再整体重新生成
只生成两层目录的 AGENTS.md

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude scan the project and generate or update hierarchical AGENTS.md files at the root and in complexity-scored subdirectories. Each file covers overview, structure, code map, conventions, anti-patterns, commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user types /init-deep or asks to initialize or rebuild the project's AGENTS.md structure. Flags include --create-new (full regeneration) and --max-depth (directory depth limit).

say_en.text: Initialize hierarchical AGENTS.md for this project.
say_en.note: Scans the structure and picks locations by complexity.

say_en.text: Rebuild AGENTS.md from scratch, reading existing ones first.
Limit AGENTS.md generation to two directory levels.
